info.title: Harpocrates Signer API
info.description: The signer of Harpocrates, the internal certificate authority: keys, certificate and revocation list signing, ceremonies and escrow. Reached only over a Unix socket, by the Harpocrates service, with a shared token.

get.description: Whether the store is initialised and unsealed, why not, and the open ceremony. Answers while sealed.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: Sets the recovery passphrase on an empty store and returns a new unseal key, once: it becomes the `harpocrates_signer_unseal_key` secret. Refused on a store that already has a master key.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: Opens the store with the recovery passphrase. This is also what lifts a deliberate seal; the unseal key alone does not.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: Forgets the keys and ends any ceremony, and stays sealed across restarts until unsealed with the recovery passphrase.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: Rewraps the master key under a new unseal key and returns it, once. The old one stops working at once; replace the secret before the next restart.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

put.description: Rewraps the master key under a new passphrase; the current one must be given.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: An issuer's key (it signs) or a subject's (it is certified, and kept: escrow). Only the public key is returned.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: An encrypted PKCS#8 key, as XCA exports it (an issuing CA's, at the cutover), or the key in a PKCS#12 file (a subject's, brought to be certified). Refused if the store already holds it.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

get.description: Its purpose, algorithm and public key; never the private key.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

delete.description: Deletes an escrowed subject key for good, keeping its public key so it can never be certified again. Issuer keys are refused.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: A subject key, encrypted: PKCS#8 PEM, PKCS#12 (AES-256), or legacy PKCS#12 (SHA-1 and 3DES, no chain). The service decides who may and records it; an issuer's key is refused.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: An issuing CA (path length 0) whose key is in the store, with the chain above it, its maximum validity and the extended key usages it may sign.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

get.description: Its certificate, chain, maximum validity and usages.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: A leaf certificate exactly as specified, after the invariants: never a CA, within the issuer's validity and maximum, its usages, and every name constraint up its chain.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: A list with the given number, dates and entries.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: The leaf the given issuer would sign from this spec, after the same invariants, signed by a throwaway key of the issuer's type: it reads as the real certificate would and never verifies. Nothing is kept and no issuer key is used, so it answers while sealed.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: Imports an offline CA's key for this ceremony only. It is forgotten when the ceremony closes, times out, the signer is sealed or restarts; one ceremony at a time.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

get.description: The open ceremony, or 404 when there is none.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.summary: Signs a certificate in a ceremony
post.description: A CA below the ceremony's (a path length below its own): an intermediate, an issuing CA whose key is in the store, or a cross-signed successor. A root that signs directly (path length 0) signs leaves instead, never a CA.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.summary: Signs a revocation list in a ceremony
post.description: The offline CA's own list.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.summary: Creates an offline intermediate in a ceremony
post.description: Generates a key, has the ceremony's CA sign it, and returns the key encrypted, once. The signer keeps nothing.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: Generates a key, self-signs, and returns the key encrypted, once. The signer keeps nothing: the root is offline from its first moment.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: An issuer's Ed25519 key that signs user or host certificates, never both, and never an X.509 issuer's key too; with the longest certificate it signs.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

get.description: Its kind, maximum validity and public key, OpenSSH format.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: A certificate exactly as specified, after the invariants: the CA's own kind, within its maximum validity, at least one principal, an OpenSSH key type and never an issuer's key, and no critical options or extensions on a host certificate.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.description: The certificate a CA of the given kind and maximum validity would sign from this spec, after the same invariants, signed by a throwaway Ed25519 key: it reads as the real one would and never verifies. No CA key is used, so it answers while sealed.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.summary: Issues an online issuer's OCSP responder
post.description: A certificate for an `ocsp` key, signed by the issuer's own key: OCSPSigning only, ocsp-nocheck, valid at most 35 days. The signer keeps it, and the key signs that issuer's responses from then on.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

post.summary: Issues an offline CA's OCSP responder in a ceremony
post.description: The same, signed by the ceremony's CA, valid at most 400 days: an offline CA's responses are signed by this responder while the CA's own key stays offline.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

409.description: The store is not in the state this needs.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

get.description: Its certificate and the CA it answers for.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Validation Error

post.description: One response per entry, each for a serial of the responder's own CA (the CertID's issuer hashes are the signer's, from the CA's certificate): good or revoked, with this thisUpdate and nextUpdate, at most a week apart and within the responder's validity.

401.description: No token, or the wrong one.

422.description: Refused: one of the signer's invariants (see `invariant`).

CertIdHash.title: CertIdHash
CertIdHash.description:
The hash a request's CertID uses: SHA-1, as RFC 5019 has clients
send, or SHA-256.

ocspUrls.title: Ocspurls
ocspUrls.description: The issuing CA's OCSP responder, http://, in the AIA.

mustStaple.title: Muststaple
mustStaple.description: OCSP must-staple: the TLS feature with status_request (RFC 7633). Only with an OCSP URL, and never for a CA.

extensions.description: `minimal`: the key identifiers only, for a leaf whose consumer accepts nothing else; keyUsage and everything after it must then be empty.

signatureHash.description: The certificate's hash; SHA-256 when absent. None for an Ed25519 issuer.

subjectKeyIdentifier.description: RFC 5280's method, RFC 7093's truncated SHA-256, or none (never for a CA).

authorityKeyIdentifier.description: The issuer's key identifier, alone or with its issuer and serial; or none.

basicConstraints.description: For a leaf (CA:FALSE); a CA's are always critical.

customExtensions.title: Customextensions
customExtensions.description: Any extension the signer does not build itself.

CertificateSpec.title: CertificateSpec
CertificateSpec.description:
Everything the certificate says. Exactly one of publicKey, csr and
keyId gives the subject's key; a CSR's own subject and extensions are
ignored, its signature is checked.

value.title: Value
value.description: The extension's value: one DER element, base64.

error.title: Error
error.description: A stable code: sealed, refused, not-found, ...

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: PEM, issuer first; left out of legacy PKCS#12.

privateKey.title: Privatekey
privateKey.description: Encrypted PKCS#8, PEM; or a PKCS#12 file, base64.

KeyAlgorithm.title: KeyAlgorithm
KeyAlgorithm.description:
What the signer generates. P-256 is the default (ADR 0018); a
certificate's key may be any of these, chosen when it is issued (ADR
0020, amended). DSA is for clients that still take it: TLS 1.3 and
browsers do not.

KeyIdentifierMethod.title: KeyIdentifierMethod
KeyIdentifierMethod.description:
RFC 5280's SHA-1 of the key's bits, or RFC 7093's leftmost 160
bits of their SHA-256; or no subject key identifier at all.

KeyPurpose.title: KeyPurpose
KeyPurpose.description:
An issuer's key signs; a subject's key is certified (and may be
escrowed); an OCSP responder's key signs a CA's OCSP responses (ADR
0036), and nothing else.

NameConstraintsSpec.title: NameConstraintsSpec
NameConstraintsSpec.description: For a CA: `ip` entries are networks (`10.0.0.0/8`).

hash.description: The CertID's hash, as clients ask.

revokedAt.title: Revokedat
revokedAt.description: When it was revoked; only when it was.

nextUpdate.title: Nextupdate
nextUpdate.description: At most a week after thisUpdate, and within the responder.

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: Each entry's signed OCSPResponse, DER, base64, in order.

OcspStatus.title: OcspStatus
OcspStatus.description:
What a response says. `unknown` is never signed ahead: a serial the
CA never issued is answered `unauthorized`, unsigned.

encryptedKey.title: Encryptedkey
encryptedKey.description: Encrypted PKCS#8, PEM: store it offline. Shown once.

certificate.description: Its certificate; no key is given: it is generated.

OfflineCaSpec.title: OfflineCaSpec
OfflineCaSpec.description: A new offline CA: a root, or an intermediate signed in a ceremony.

privateKey.title: Privatekey
privateKey.description: The offline CA's encrypted PKCS#8, PEM.

cpsUri.title: Cpsuri
cpsUri.description: Where its certification practice statement is.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: The CAs above it, PEM, nearest first.

extendedKeyUsages.title: Extendedkeyusages
extendedKeyUsages.description: Dotted OIDs the issuer may put in a certificate.

PreviewCertificateRequest.title: PreviewCertificateRequest
PreviewCertificateRequest.description:
A leaf as an issuer would sign it, the issuer given rather than
registered: an issuing CA, or a root that signs directly.

PreviewSshCertificateRequest.title: PreviewSshCertificateRequest
PreviewSshCertificateRequest.description: An SSH certificate as a CA of this kind would sign it.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: The CAs above it, PEM, nearest first; their name constraints and extended key usages bind what it signs.

extendedKeyUsages.title: Extendedkeyusages
extendedKeyUsages.description: Dotted OIDs this issuer may put in a certificate.

keyId.title: Keyid
keyId.description: An issuer's Ed25519 key in the store.

caCertificate.title: Cacertificate
caCertificate.description: The CA it answers for, PEM.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: RFC 4514, e.g. CN=ncfritz.net TLS Issuing CA 1 - G1 OCSP

keyId.title: Keyid
keyId.description: An `ocsp` key, P-256, with no responder yet.

ResponderSpec.title: ResponderSpec
ResponderSpec.description:
An OCSP responder's certificate: for an `ocsp` key, issued by the
CA it answers for.

SealReason.title: SealReason
SealReason.description: Why the signer is sealed; what the service shows and alerts on.

publicKey.title: Publickey
publicKey.description: The CA's key, OpenSSH format: what TrustedUserCAKeys and @cert-authority lines carry.

sourceAddresses.title: Sourceaddresses
sourceAddresses.description: CIDRs the certificate is used from.

SshExtension.title: SshExtension
SshExtension.description: OpenSSH's extensions; each, when present, permits what it names.

reason.description: Why it is sealed, if it is.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Keys held, not counting destroyed ones.

unsealKeyFile.title: Unsealkeyfile
unsealKeyFile.description: The name of the file it reads its unseal key from at start (SIGNER_UNSEAL_KEY_FILE), without its directory: inside a container the directory is the secrets mount, not the host's.

unsealKey.title: Unsealkey
unsealKey.description: 32 bytes, base64: the Compose secret. Shown once.
